title: Correcting Human Labels for Rater Effects in AI Evaluation: An Item Response Theory Approach

bias_targets.methodology: Estimating individual rater severity parameters using the Many-Facet Rasch Model (MFRM) from Item Response Theory (IRT) to adjust for human annotators consistently assigning higher or lower scores independent of actual output quality.

Quantifying centrality and extremity by estimating the standard deviation of rater threshold parameters in the MFRM, which identifies annotator tendencies to overuse the middle or extreme ends of a Likert-style rating scale.
